narrative: On the part. The old part in his hand, flour still in the hair, the side of the stage. The book is not open for writing. Ink from the week is still on the finger. On the part. The strip rolled. He is off. The flour has not been brushed out. The hair keeps a white at the temple. No face turned to the yard.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the Ghost and left the flour in place.

entities.name: the old Hamlet
entities.context: Shown on part in The Ghost at two
